openings.claim: Join surname divider cards, which narrow shelf search regions, to the daily paper exception slip, which records holds temporarily elsewhere, through a shared divider-zone key. Behind the desk, each zone points to its corresponding exception-slip section; the clerk checks that section before searching the shelf region.
openings.delta: The shared key permits a first-location routing decision: search the normal region or the recorded exception location. Exceptions remain on the existing slip; cards retain their region-narrowing function. Any location change requires a pencil correction, whose feasibility remains unproven.
openings.prediction: With equally current records, matching zone links should reduce exception-lookup time and second-location searches beyond separately using cards and a flat slip. Household-name mismatches and wrong-reader risk remain unresolved; the 95% target is unproven.
openings.rival_prediction: Freshness alone is the nearest alternative: an equally current flat slip should perform as well, and scrambling zone links should have no additional effect.
openings.defeat: The proposal is defeated if an equally current flat slip matches routing time and second-search frequency, matched links outperform neither parent combination nor scrambled links, or maintenance exceeds ten daily clerk-minutes.
openings.probe: Evaluate a bounded paper rehearsal, not an established intervention. The existing clerk compares identical stipulated pickup sequences across four arrangements, including cart arrivals and household mismatches. Keep records behind the desk, use existing furniture and paper, and stop total preparation plus rehearsal at ten clerk-minutes. Record routing time and errors; incomplete comparisons establish no benefit.
assumptions: Fit concerns only the capped rehearsal.
Sufficient clerk time for informative comparisons is unconfirmed.
Current exception locations and reliable reader-to-hold verification are prerequisites, not verified capabilities.
Intervention maintenance within ten daily clerk-minutes remains unconfirmed.

component_comparison.baseline: Surname shelves: predicts shelf search followed by possible second-location search.
component_comparison.parent_a: Divider cards: predicts narrower shelf search, without exception routing.
component_comparison.parent_b: Daily exception slip: predicts exception routing when entries are current, without divider narrowing.
component_comparison.hybrid: Shared zone interface: predicts faster exception lookup plus narrowed normal search under identical staffing, privacy, furniture, time and correctness requirements.
component_comparison.interaction_test: Compare linked cards/slip against cards plus an equally current flat slip; scramble only zone links while holding content constant. An interaction requires a matched-link advantage, not merely summed parent benefits.
